data.narrative:
Raphe mPhibr is a Series B–stage defense and security company founded by Vivek and Vikash Mishra that has raised $145M+ to date. The valuation assessment draws from a peer set of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $145M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $276M. Peer-median analysis across 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with the peer set ranging from $300M (floor) to $3.0B (ceiling). The latter method reflects material dispersion in how the market values defense-tech companies at this stage.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $234M to $1.1B, with a median of $638M. The wide spread reflects meaningful uncertainty: stage-progression conservatively anchors below peer median, suggesting either that Raphe mPhibr trades at a discount to the peer cohort or that stage-progression methodology underweights the capital intensity and defensibility typical of this sector. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, customer concentration, and relative technology differentiation versus the named peers.
